bullets.text: Apple Ends iPhone Upgrade Program - **Apple** discontinues the iPhone Upgrade Program in the UK, introducing a new Flexible Finance Account.
iOS 26.2 Enhances Reminders - New 'Urgent' alarms in **iOS 26.2** improve task management with timely alerts.
Apple Wallet's New Credit Card Feature - **iOS 26** introduces systemwide AutoFill for credit card details, enhancing user convenience.
Criminal Record Season 2 Coming - **Apple TV** announces the return of the acclaimed crime thriller, premiering April 22.
Grok CSAM Issue Escalates - **Apple** and **Google** face pressure as 37 US states respond to the Grok chatbot's CSAM problem.
AirTag 2 Introduces Precision Finding - **AirTag 2** expands its Precision Finding feature to the **Apple Watch**, enhancing item tracking.
Apple's New Messages Feature - **iOS 26** improves spam filtering in Messages with the 'Screen Unknown Senders' option.
iOS 26.3 Location Privacy Feature - New feature limits cellular networks' access to user location data, but requires Apple's modem.
